entities.name: Amino alcohol imidazole substrate
observations: Contains a free alpha-amino group suitable for acylation.

entities.name: Carboxylic acid substrate
observations: Contains a carboxylic acid and an N-carbamoyl-protected amino group.

entities.name: DPPA
observations: Decoded reagent is diphenyl phosphoryl azide, [N-]=[N+]=NP(=O)(phenyl)phenyl, a peptide-coupling reagent.

entities.name: DPPA coupling conditions
observations: Triethylamine and DMF accompany DPPA, consistent with activation of a carboxylic acid for amide formation.
Predicted transformation is condensation of the acid substrate with the free amine of the amino alcohol substrate.

entities.name: Coupled amide product
observations: RDKit-valid structure; formula C34H52N6O5; calculated molecular weight 624.83.
The new bond is between the free amino nitrogen of the first substrate and the carboxyl carbon of the second substrate; three carbonyl groups are present.
